prereg.written: 2026-10-10, before any engine derivative was evaluated
prereg.design_criterion_verbatim: Chain PASS if the three identities hold to 1e-6 (predicted FAIL on thermal-vs-acoustics - report, don't fix). Observability: every material effect >= 1e5 below its floor (predicted 5-9 orders); clocks are the only channel and S9a has closed it. No thesis weight.

identities.I2: d ln v_L/d sigma - 0.5*(d ln K/d sigma - d ln rho/d sigma), |.| < 1e-6
identities.I3_design_sketch: d ln vD_thermal/d sigma - d ln v_L/d sigma, |.| < 1e-6
identities.I3_like_for_like: d ln vD_thermal/d sigma - d ln vD_acoustics/d sigma, |.| < 1e-6 (same quantity, two modules)

predictions_from_code_reading.dlnrho: +0.9904 (= f_QCD, by construction); I1 residual ~1e-9 PASS
predictions_from_code_reading.dlnK: about +0.005 (ZPE correction: (9/8) k_B Theta_D/E_coh * f_QCD/2); dlnG = dlnE = dlnK (nu sigma-free)
predictions_from_code_reading.dlnvL: about -0.493; I2 residual ~1e-9 PASS (by construction, G proportional to K)
predictions_from_code_reading.dlnvD_thermal: about +0.0025 (rho frozen at rho_0); I3 residual = 0.5*f_QCD = 0.495 FAIL (both forms)
predictions_from_code_reading.dlnThetaD: about +0.0025 as coded; consistent chain -0.493; the code's sign is opposite to the physics
predictions_from_code_reading.dlnTm_Lindemann: about +0.005 as coded = dlnK; consistent chain also dlnK (frozen M and frozen rho cancel); docstring claims T_m decreases with sigma - contradicted
predictions_from_code_reading.dlncp: about -6e-4 as coded (rho frozen); consistent chain about -0.87
predictions_from_code_reading.dlncs_air: about -0.490 (argon mass sigma-invariant in atmosphere.py); with argon coupled about -0.496

observability_floors_fixed_now.note: best demonstrated relative resolution, order of magnitude, all [LIT] verified by web search 2026-10-10; the smallest verified figure is used so that 'below floor' is the conservative claim
rho: Bartl et al. 2017 Metrologia 54, 693: N_A by XRCD to 1.2e-8 (sphere density/volume limited); NMIJ sphere density 2320.070841(76) kg/m3 = 3.3e-8
K_G_E: DERIVED from LIT: M = rho v^2 with pulse-echo v precision 1e-7 (Pantea et al. 2005 RSI 76, 114902)
v_L_v_T_v_D: Pantea et al. 2005 RSI 76, 114902: digital pulse-echo precision exceeds 1 part in 1e7
Theta_D: DERIVED from LIT: Theta_D proportional to v_D at fixed n; same pulse-echo floor
T_melt: DERIVED from LIT: NIST, 13 Ga melting-point cells span 0.04 mK at 302.9146 K
c_p: LIT: adiabatic calorimetry of Cu agrees with references to 0.1 % (Stevens & Boerio-Goates 2004, J. Chem. Thermodyn., doi 10.1016/j.jct.2004.06.008)
c_s_air: DERIVED from LIT: acoustic gas thermometry k_B to 0.71 ppm (de Podesta et al. 2013 Metrologia 50, 354), k_B proportional to c^2

prereg.sigma_increments: Delta sigma per km = 2 xi g (1 km)/c^2 and Delta sigma annual amplitude = 2 xi e r_s,sun/(2a); field-equation normalisation sigma = -2 xi Phi/c^2 as headline, inventory normalisation (x1/2) also reported
prereg.my_forecast_against_design_criterion: FAIL on the annual channel: rho (~2.4 orders below floor), v_L / v_T / consistent v_D and Theta_D (~3.6), air c_s (~4.1) are inside 1e5 of their floors; per-km channel passes everywhere (>= 5.5). Every property-metrology row is still below its floor (unobservable). A frequency-metrology row (acoustic resonator vs atomic clock, Campbell et al. 2021 PRL 126, 071301; Lo et al. 2016 PRX 6, 011018) is NOT below floor and is added as a design correction, not as a change of criterion.
prereg.clock_row: Lange et al. 2021 PRL 126, 011102: (c^2/mu) d mu/d Phi = 7(45)e-8; sigma-bridge prediction -2 xi f_QCD = -0.313 (field) / -0.157 (inventory); predicted excluded x 3.2e5 / 1.6e5 at |central| + 2 sigma
